x: It is with deep regret that we have to announce the death of Frank William (Billy) Pritchard. Billy was a Lieutenant in the Anti-Tank Regt. and was killed action in North Africa on November 26th.
Belgrave entries for that meeting included E Gray (100 yds) T D Wiley (100 yds) reserves F W Pritchard and S C Botwright. 440 yds D G Michael, H E Pack, reserves T H Scrimshaw & A A Bird.
